decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed extensions would have an adverse effect on neighbouring residents in terms of daylight and outlook contrary to policies: ENV-B.1.1. (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Residential Extensions.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The design, bulk and massing of the proposed extensions would be out of character with surrounding development and would represent an intrusive, ungainly and overbearing structure, which would be detrimental to the character of the area and the outlook from neighbouring residential properties contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1. (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Residential Extensions and Conservation Areas.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed development would harm the character and appearance of the Chiswick House Area Conservation Area contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1. (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Residential Extensions and Conservation Areas.
description: Erection of a single storey rear/side extension, front extension, re-modelling of front elevation and erection of a second floor to house, together with first and second floor canopies to rear (PLEASE NOTE AMENDED DESCRIPTION)
